summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 5,000,000 ordinary shares at a VWAP of 104.5570 pence per share. The purchases were executed through Goldman Sachs International under an existing buyback program announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. This is a routine continuation of a disclosed buyback, not an accelerated or special tender. As an ordinary share buyback, it falls under capital returns. No premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. There is no special situation catalyst; the filing is routine with no risk-arb angle.
